verdict.rationale: Framer documents a Server API, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask for. However, the evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the external-agent connection are adjacent features, not a downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
